title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 24, 2026, relative to a Personal Expense Statement of
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 24, 2026, relative to a Personal Expense Statement of
  Chief of Police Jim McDonnell, for expenses incurred on October 20, 2026, through October 26, 2026,
  as set forth.  [BPC #26-362]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report.
summary: The Police Commission is asked to approve a report on Chief Jim McDonnell's personal expense statement for expenses incurred October 20-26, 2026.
